newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Banks back Carlyle purchase of Aerostructure.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Banks back Carlyle purchase of Aerostructure.

text.p: NEW YORK, Sept 12 (LPC) - Buyout firm Carlyle Group has tapped Bankers Trust New York Corp and BankAmerica Corp's Bank of America for a $165 million bank loan in support of Carlyles purchase of Textron Incs' Aerostructures division, banking sources said.
The credit will be launched into the syndicated loan market at a bank meeting in New York today, sources added.
The loan will consist of a $25 million revolving credit and $140 million of "institutional" term loans, which will be sold to prime rate funds and insurance companies, a banker said.

The revolving portion of the loan is priced at 250 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR), while the term loans are priced at 250 to 325 basis points over LIBOR, according to several sources.
Nashville-based Aerostructures produces aircraft wings and wing components for the business jet and commercial and military transport markets.
Its 1996 revenues are estimated at approximately $190 million, lenders said.
Among Washington, D.C.-based Carlyles most recent purchases are Howmet Corp and Contour Aerospace.
